title: Member API containment · recorded session

messages.text: Ask me for the incident status, or start a member API lab. I can prepare a bounded repair and show its evidence.
Alexa, what is the incident status?
THREAT CONTAINED. 25 of 25 checks pass. This is saved AWS evidence.
Alexa, start the member API lab.
The member API lab has a healthy baseline. Ask me to prepare a repair to inject the selected fault, preserve its evidence and request a diagnosis.

Unauthorized reads are bypassing scoped authentication.
Approved runbook: ENFORCE_MEMBER_API_SCOPE.
The repair has not been applied. Confirm the approved repair to continue.
PATCH performed the completed repair, and I recorded the verified result. Unauthorized lab access was blocked, and 25 passing checks confirmed this is the disposable lab.
The reference model is RECOVERY_ONLY_CANDIDATE. Missing evidence and known failures remain separate. This calculation is read-only; it cannot authorize the live repair.
The reference planner recommends 2 evidence probes within 6 illustrative units. These are modelling units, not AWS prices. No probe has run.
